ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.6
   C. 33
   D. 27.7

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 60
   B. 38
   C. 30
   D. 19

3. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15
   C. 21
   D. 15.6

4. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 2/2

5. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x

6. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 100
   B. 11
   C. 50
   D. 10

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 44
   C. 30
   D. 15

8. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 37
   C. 31.7
   D. 31

9. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23.6
   C. 29
   D. 23

10. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 25

11. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

12. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 2

13. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.7
   C. 19.6
   D. 19

14. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 37

15. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 1
   D. 2

16. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 36
   C. 6
   D. 18

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
